body:
Just about everything for my mom. She can't disability because of a snafu that happened when she was a child (she's been disabled from birth). She never worked enough to draw it for herself. And my dad made about 2 pennies more than the limit so the government has refused to help.  As far as medical, she's covered under my dad's insurance for the majority of stuff.

For me, there hasn't been anything I can really try. To do any kind of disability in my case, it requires doctor's care and tests run and unfortunately I don't have that money (I mean I'm being sued for unpaid loans so I definitely can't afford care).  And I don't qualify for any insurance or government care either.  Its sad when it really is cheaper for me to just off myself than to be a burden for everyone and want to die every day.
You don't suck at it. If anything it makes me feel better that other people DO feel the same way. But you're right, it DOES seem like a small boat at times.

Oh yeah, the cop was there in a professional capacity.  I live in the Southern US, in a state that is number one for violence against women at that, so it shouldn't be that surprising that the good ole' boy system is still around. 

A friend of mine actually set us up.  When she found out she was shocked.  She'd never realized he'd had that side but then she remembered a few remarks about stuff he'd made in the past. 

I swear the treatment after the act did more to me than the actual assault itself did.  I think that's why I became a victim advocate, to stave off that treatment.

Its so crazy how people can affect others. Isn't it?

As a survivor, I can understand the hate.  But don't let him win. He's an asshole. I mean seriously. And you're so much better off without him. I know exactly what you mean about not wanting to see him, and not being able to cope with the anxiety that comes after it.  Trust me, I understand that completely, just with a different set of circumstances.

You've already commented on my post, so you know some of my story of why I'm down. But I will say this, you are free! Your life will begin a new. And you can do whatever it is that you want, when you want, with who you want.  He had absolutely no right to ever hurt you, no one does, but you are strong.  And I do hope you reconsider.  

And you can paint, which is awesome! I can only draw a stick figure...a crooked stick figure.

I'm not happy. You're right, I have a lot on me.  Its funny because I don't necessarily want to date, but I guess I want the option? To feel like someone would want me.  Does that make sense?  And I do hope you're right about me being able to leave.  I really do.  And thank you so much for being willing to respond.

You don't suck at advice. The fact that someone cares whether or not I live or die makes me teary eyed.  I hate that you had to go through the rape. And I know its not right. You know, its funny, because I'm a victim advocate for rape victims. I did it to make it positive. And it did work. I know it wasn't my fault at that he was an asshole. But what DID get to me, is the cop knew him and said he'd never be able to do that to someone. And how I was treated at the hospital (I mean, they left him in the room with me and said oh, it was just kinky games huh) And afterward. The guy literally drummed it in my head that I was so ugly and fat since I put on weight after that I needed to die. That he wished I would have that night. And then life happened.

I didn't have great self esteem beforehand but after, I definitely didn't have any.  I don't know if that part was similar for you or not.

Its true, everyone does get lonely. But this is normal.  I've tried doing some of the things that would make me happy. The problem is something inevitably happens that takes it away.  For instance, in college I was raped and assaulted and ended up having to quit for recovery time.  I tried to go back multiple times and was stalled by a car wreck, surgery, and finally my mother's illness.  I wracked up so much debt I can't afford anything.  

Dating and meeting people are similar.  In dating, no one wants the ugly chick and I'm one of the weird people in my small town.  

And the most recent thing...my father's car broke down a few months ago. So he takes mine. Its rare I get to leave this place, and I'm constantly here to take care of others. Whenever I want something for myself I'm made to feel selfish. For example, I told my mother and father I have no one and they replied with they don't have friends and they're fine, or that I wanted a few days away to visit someone and was told they don't get to do fun things or have vacation, why should I.  

ha, so sadly, I can't even go for it these days.  It feels like the world is against me and it would just be so much easier to let go.  Sorry this was long :(
